question: Does the frozen target-constrained source correction retain its small probability advantage in Hangzhou on six new PP hours?
previous_status: HOLD_TARGET_SHRINK_DEVELOPMENT remains unchanged. This is a narrower, city-specific confirmation, not a retrospective pass of the original two-city gate.
candidate: Exactly tsc_corridor_target_shrink_20261109. Read its frozen training_result.json; deterministically reconstruct the identical source/adapt histogram heads and verify metadata. Never call fit_block or fit a new lambda using the confirmation data.
budget: Six new Hangzhou native PhasePressure (PP) hours of 3600s, one pass per seed. No new source/adaptation hours, tuning, alternate-action branches or learned-controller closed-loop runs.
training: Original other-city Jinan donor 76110801-08 only; Hangzhou adaptation blocks 76111701-02, 03-04, 05-06 unchanged. No original dev seed or pilot reused as confirmation.
jinan: Retain all original negative/zero results. Its S=P=T is an algebraic consequence of all frozen weights being zero; allocate no new Jinan hours to retest this identity. Do not pool the two cities or claim Jinan source value.
collection: Reuse the original repaired Hangzhou network, detector and collection executor under SUMO 1.22.0. Preserve identity accounting, competing/terminal/censored/unknown outcomes and every started seed. Store all raw records server-side, in a new directory.
primary: All-observable matched non-spillback moving-flight risk set with a complete future10s window; raw detector CDF Brier averaged over flight snapshots and horizons1..10 within each hour, then six hours equally. Paired contrasts S-T and S-P; no alternate main subset.
inference: Report all six paired differences, three block means, absolute/relative differences and separate approximate paired-seed 95% t intervals with df=5. The seed is the uncertainty unit; flight/query repetitions are not independent samples. No sample expansion after results.
classification: Both mean contrasts negative -> DIRECTION_REPLICATED. Both approximate95% interval upper bounds strictly below0 -> PROBABILITY_INCREMENT_SUPPORTED. Otherwise report INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_REPLICATED as applicable. Both contrasts must satisfy each condition; do not select the favorable one.
secondary: Original common-scored scope, hard endpoint edge-count MAE, h10 bias/Brier, source/plain/placebo/history/analytic raw probabilities, all request pairs, and PP-label nominal13s score contrasts. Keep per-seed score signs and magnitudes; no new score threshold gate or claim of action causality.
technical_admission: Require the same16TLS/48monitored-link geometry, complete native clock/roster and accounted labels for every scheduled hour. A failed/partial seed remains in the manifest with its failure; no replacement. If the complete six-seed panel cannot be evaluated, report HOLD_INCOMPLETE_CONFIRMATION without deleting the failure.
stopping: One six-hour panel, one frozen candidate. No refit, threshold/feature/weight edits, seed substitution, further sample collection, native branches or paper changes after viewing results. Probability evidence does not establish waiting-time or counterfactual control benefit.
execution: Only jtl110gpu/jtl110gpu2/jtl311linux for new runs. Prefer jtl110gpu2 where the training records and SUMO1.22 runtime already exist. Old nodes may serve existing input files only. Pull compact results/logs; no raw trajectory/model downloads.
